description: Raised enclosed watch balcony with telescopic sculpture, parapet, back access and eight-half-step descending stair to lower landing.
differences: Packaged enclosed 13-block-deep aquarium ruins behind the viewing glass; stepped ruined pillars, arch, live coral and seagrass are actual blocks in this NBT. Stair compartment stays dry.
Telescope is gold/glass block sculpture, not a usable spyglass.
Real four-block floor-height difference is traversed by 0.5-height slab steps; checked with native body collision.
Upper platform dry; lower landing contains isolated shallow coral pool.
water_policy: DRY HABITABLE COMPARTMENT, contained wet aquarium planters and shallow pools; not a fully flooded ocean ruin. All route goals remain dry. Glass enclosure for deployment preparation, not certified deep-ocean pressure/oxygen safety.
